rooms.name: Vampire's room
rooms.short: A room with a door on the far left and a vampire standing right of centre, who won't let you through.
rooms.long: A room where a vampire stands in your way, a little right of centre. The game describes him as looking like Yoda, but a little taller, and he won't let you come through. A door on the far left leads back to where you arrived.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only

101.label: door on the far left, back to where you arrived

51.name: vampire
51.description: A vampire who won't let you come through. The game says he looks like Yoda, but a little taller.
51.note: Engine name is VAMPIRE; the engine renames it "yoda" after the first look. Hero speaks first-person in the engine text, so the description is a third-person paraphrase of the look line.

rooms.name: Below the well
rooms.short: The place where chapter 3 begins. A door on the far right leads on.
rooms.long: The place where chapter 3 begins, reached from the well at the end of chapter 2. A door stands at the far right of the room, and it is the only exit you can see.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only

99.label: hidden spot high on the left wall
99.note: Hidden all chapter (visible 0) and not shown to the player. Census says toRoom 20 with a destination point at (126, 154), inside this room's own walking area, so it loops back to room 20 rather than reaching a new room. Not a real way out; review whether to omit it from the merged pack.

100.label: door on the far right, to the vampire's room
